jobs.title: Entry-Level Security Officer – Training Provided
jobs.description:
Entry-Level Security Officer – Training ProvidedJob Description

ORN Security Solutions is looking for dependable people who are interested in starting a career in the private security industry.

No previous security experience is required.

In fact, we're specifically interested in people who are willing to learn. If you've thought about working in security but didn't know how to get started, this may be a good opportunity to get your foot in the door.

This is an entry-level position starting at $14.00 per hour. Both full-time and part-time schedules are available.

We want to be upfront about the starting wage. We're looking for people who want an opportunity to learn the profession, gain real-world experience, and potentially advance into positions with greater responsibility as they gain experience and additional licensing.

What You'll Do

This is a professional security position. Depending on your assigned shift, responsibilities may include:

  • Monitoring entrances and access points
  • Observing activity on the property
  • Conducting routine foot or property patrols as assigned
  • Helping maintain a safe and orderly environment
  • Professionally interacting with employees, visitors and members of the public
  • Identifying and reporting unusual or suspicious activity
  • Completing basic written activity and incident reports when necessary
  • Following site procedures and instructions
  • Contacting supervisors or emergency services when appropriate

This is not a law-enforcement position. We emphasize observation, professionalism, communication, documentation and good judgment.

What We're Looking For

Experience isn't our biggest concern. Reliability is.

We're looking for people who:

  • Show up when they're scheduled
  • Arrive on time
  • Have reliable transportation
  • Can communicate professionally
  • Can remain alert and attentive during a shift
  • Are comfortable working independently
  • Can follow instructions and established procedures
  • Are willing to learn
  • Take pride in their appearance and professionalism
  • Can meet the requirements to work legally in the Texas private security industry

New to Security? That's Okay.

Everybody in this industry started somewhere.

We're a locally owned DFW security company, and we're willing to work with the right people who have the attitude and reliability we're looking for.

We'll help you understand the job, learn professional security practices, and gain actual experience in the field. For employees interested in making security a career, there may also be opportunities to pursue additional training, licensing and greater responsibility as our company grows.

We would rather find a dependable person with the right attitude and teach them than hire someone with years of experience who doesn't take the job seriously.

Position Details

Pay: $14.00 per hour
Job Types: Full-time and Part-time
Location: Dallas, Texas
Experience: No previous security experience required

About ORN Security Solutions

ORN Security Solutions is a locally owned Dallas-Fort Worth security company providing professional security and patrol services throughout the area.

We believe good security starts with dependable people, professional conduct and doing the job the right way.

If you're looking for an opportunity to enter the security profession and you're willing to show up, learn and work, we'd like to hear from you.

ORN Security Solutions
Defend. Deter. Deliver.

Pay: From $14.00 per hour

Application Question(s):

  • Are you willing to complete the training and licensing requirements necessary to work as a security officer in Texas?
  • What interests you about starting a career in the security industry?

Shift availability:

  • Day Shift (Preferred)
  • Night Shift (Preferred)
  • Overnight Shift (Preferred)

Ability to Commute:

  • Dallas, TX 75237 (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Armed Vault Custodian PM
jobs.description:
Job Description

With a network of nearly 200 branches, Loomis armored transportation, cash management centers, and cash inventory vaults keep cash flowing throughout financial institutions and retail businesses across the US. Loomis prides itself on providing employees with opportunities for career advancement and job satisfaction. In fact, many of our company’s managers, vice presidents, and corporate executives started out in the branches as driver/guards and tellers. Our work can be challenging, but the thousands who have stayed with our company for decades will tell you that if you have the desire to learn and the drive to succeed, Loomis is the place to be. Come join our team!

Job Description

As a Vault Custodian, you work with your team to maintain inventory in our cash vaults for our Loomis customers.

Responsibilities

  • Check identifying numbers or seals on bags of deposits and/or change shipments against the receipts accompanying each bag, or against the provided manifests
  • Count items, record amounts and serial numbers, sign and date receipts and manifests
  • Load/unload wagons or flatbed carts with bags/boxes of coin
  • Sort individual cargo items by route
  • Communicate verbally with co-workers and with customers via telephone

Requirements

  • Ability to load/unload bags/boxes of currency, checks, and coin weighing an average of 50 lbs. per item several times during a 6 to 10 hour shift, 5 to 6 days a week
  • Ability to push wagons, carts, buggies, dollies loaded with cargo weighing up to several hundred pounds
  • Unrestricted ability to repetitiously bend, stoop, squat, stand, walk, climb, twist, turn, and reach out
  • Ability to perform repetitious lifting of items weighing an average of 50 lbs. each from floor
  • Ability to walk continuously between bins, vaults, booths, and counters
  • Ability to stand on concrete floor approximately 80 percent of shift
  • Ability to sign and record numbers by hand and to make entries on records and prepare reports.
  • Ability to count, add, subtract and balance columns of numbers
  • A valid firearms permit or ability to pass applicable firearms requirements per the state to which you are applying is required.

Working Conditions

  • Work in a room within a vault with little or no exposure to outside light
  • Full-time schedule can potentially consist of an average of 40 to 50 hours/week, with a minimum of 5 days during a 6-day period

Essential Functions/Job Qualifications

  • Ability to maintain a stooped or squatting position for several minutes to perform the sorting function.
  • Ability to walk continuously between bins, vaults, booths, counters.
  • Ability to stand on concrete floor approximately 80 percent of shift.
  • Ability to read and speak the English language sufficiently to converse with co-workers and customers, and to read receipts, manifests and reports.
  • Ability to sign and record numbers by hand and to make entries on records and prepare reports.
  • Ability to count, add, subtract and balance columns of numbers.
  • Ability to meet State requirements for handgun license/permit or Security Officer Commission.

*As part of the qualification process for the Vault Custodian position, a Human Performance Evaluation (HPE) is required. This evaluation requires successful completion of testing in the below areas.*

  • Lift: 25lbs vertical lift from 10 inches to 66 inches from the floor (1X)
  • Lift-Carry: 18lbs vertical lift from 1 inch to 44 inches from the floor, and horizontally transfer 15ft (4X), 18lbs vertical lift from 10 inches to 36 inches from the floor and horizontally transfer 300ft (1X) and 50lbs vertical lift from 10 inches to 36 inches from the floor and horizontally transfer 2ft (2X)
  • Push-Pull: Horizontally transfer 47lbs of force on a sled (single, non-dominant arm), a distance of 1ft (2X)
  • Repetitive Coupling: Squeeze Jamar Hand Dynamometer requiring forces up to 30lbs / both right & left hands (4X each)

Benefits

Loomis offers one of the most comprehensive employees benefit packages in the industry, which includes:

  • Vacation and Sick Time (PTO) as well as Paid Holidays
  • Health & Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) Plan
  • Basic Life Insurance Plan
  • Voluntary Life Insurance Plan
  • Flexible Spending and Health Savings Account
  • Dependent Care Account
  • Industry leading Training and Development

Loomis is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Drug Free Workplace. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status or disability.
